subject: The truth about 90% of users who skip this step
preview_text: There's a hidden feature most couples never find. Here's why you're missing out on the best part of SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. When we built SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together, we didn't just want to give you date ideas. We wanted to give you a legacy. A story you'd tell your grandkids about how you kept the spark alive for decades. But here's the thing: most people never get past the first few dates. They treat the app like a vending machine for ideas, not like a partner in their love story.

You're not that person. You're here because you believe relationships take work, and you're willing to put in that work. That's why you've stuck around. But I've noticed something: you haven't tried the one feature that turns this app from a tool into a ritual. The feature that makes couples say 'this is ours.'

It's the shared wishlist. Not just a list of dates you want to try, but a living document of your shared future. Every time you add a dream vacation, a cozy night in, or a wild adventure, you're telling your partner 'I see a future with you.' It's the most romantic thing you can do outside of an actual date. And it's been sitting there, waiting for you to use it.

Open the app right now. Go to your profile. Add one thing to your shared wishlist. Just one. Then message your partner and tell them you added it. I promise you'll feel different. P.S. Couples who use the wishlist together report 40% higher relationship satisfaction. Don't let your love story be average.
